```{r}
df |> 
  filter(!is.na(v6_kaminoko_visits)) |> 
  mutate(
    kaminoko_dummy = case_when(
      v6_kaminoko_visits == "はじめて" ~ "はじめて",
      v6_kaminoko_visits == "2回目" | v6_kaminoko_visits == " 3回目以上" ~ "2回目以上",
      TRUE ~ v6_kaminoko_visits
    )
  ) |> select(kaminoko_dummy)
```
